modern: Today I have got out of all trouble, or rather I have thrown out all trouble, for it was not outside, but within and in my opinions.
original: To-day I have got out of all trouble, or rather I have cast out all trouble, for it was not outside, but within and in my opinions.
notification: Today I have got out of all trouble, or rather I have thrown out all trouble, for it was not outside, but within and in my opinions.
notification_original: To-day I have got out of all trouble, or rather I have cast out all trouble, for it was not outside, but within and in my opinions.

explained.summary: Today Marcus says he has escaped all his troubles, then corrects himself: he has thrown them out. They were never outside him but in his own opinions about things. Change the judgement and the trouble goes with it.
explained.today: The traffic jam, the unanswered email, the dismissive remark in a meeting: the irritation that follows you home is mostly the story you’re telling about them, and that story is the part you can put down.
